dog.description_text: Meet Sammie, a sweet 13-year-old girl who is looking for a loving home to spend her golden years! Sammie is a super friendly and affectionate companion who loves being around people and soaking up attention. She is happiest wherever her people are, whether that's hanging out in the kitchen, relaxing in the living room, or cuddling up on the couch. Sammie knows "sit," enjoys playing catch, and absolutely loves car rides! She is also comfortable being bathed and brushed by her family. Sammie would love a home where she can enjoy plenty of companionship, affection, and cozy days by your side. Her previous family shared that she loves attention and will even cry for extra love and quality time. At 13 years old, Sammie still has so much love to give and is hoping to find a family who will cherish her and make her feel loved and secure. Could Sammie be the perfect addition to your home?
dog.name: Sammie
